reason: Most proposals describe the same 16-call panel32 wrapper, so they are one experiment hypothesis rather than independent evidence; I rank its repeated descriptions first for the fixed n=512 workload. Prior panel ABI checks and the unused-helper baseline establish correctness and a fresh comparison identity, not speed. The helper may reduce each packed panel from 128 KiB to 64 KiB, but its sixteen calls, repeated packing, and SME transitions may erase that benefit. B-panel packing adds a 1 MiB allocation and copy, and its compatibility with the helper's internal operand interpretation is unresolved, so it ranks lower. Tail alignment targets only the general fallback, not the timed n=512 path.
